description: Installation of a replacement recessed ground floor front Crittal glazed shopfront, with a glazed single front door, serving hatch window and bifolding windows, to form a ground floor front undercroft, two ground floor front undercroft side seats and a roof light to the existing single storey rear extension (to No. 32 Devonshire Road), retrospective erection of a replacement single storey rear extension with the installation of a replacement single rear door (with matching infilling of the existing rear door’s void) (to No. 34 Devonshire Road), and installation of a kitchen air extraction system (with an external rear duct, silencer and vent), toilet air extraction system (with two rear vents) and one rear air conditioning unit (within a louvred enclosure) to the existing building.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  A-207A, A-209 Received: 25 September 2026;  A-205, A-206 Received: 11 September 2026;  A-208, Unreferenced Environmental Noise Assessment Received: 26 August 2026;  Unreferenced Flood Risk Assessment Received:  04 August 2026;  G-004, Single-phase outdoor unit AJY045LCLDH for Fujitsu Airstage VRF system J-IVS Series, Unreferenced Kitchen Extraction System Report and Odour Risk Assessment, Unreferenced Silent Fan Specification, Unreferenced Slim Duct Specification, Unreferenced Vibration Statement, Unreferenced Wall-Mounted ECO Range Specification Received: 28 July 2026;  A - 100, A - 200, A - 201, A - 202, A - 203, A - 204, BR-005, BR-013, greenhaus Design and Access Statement, PP-15025976v3, Unreferenced Fire Safety Statement Received:  27 July 2026.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The external rear wall of the replacement single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall be finished with white/ cream painted render or painted white or cream only within six months of this decision notice being issued, and be permanently retained as such.  

Reasons:  The enhance the appearance of the building and Conservation Area.

Condition : 4 - The first floor amenity terrace privacy fencing installed to No. 34 Devonshire Road's replacement single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall be timber slatted panel fencing only, be installed within six months of this decision notice being issued and be permanently retained as such.  

Reasons:  To protect the character and appearance of the building and Conservation Area.

Condition : 5 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) hereby permitted, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that it operates, in accordance with Environmental Noise Assessment hereby permitted.  

The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises, or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard 4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/ or its subsequently amended equivalent.  

b) The mechanical plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.   

c) Following installation of the mechanical plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) hereby permitted, a Post Completion Noise Assessment shall be submitted for the approval of the Local Planning Authority which demonstrates the actual measured noise rating level of all installed mechanical plant operating under normal conditions.  

All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of British Standard 4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/ or its subsequently amended equivalent.  

The Post Completion Noise Report shall be completed and submitted to the Local Planning Authority within 28 days of mechanical plant hereby permitted being installed.  

If the plant fails to meet the specified standard, remedial measures shall be put in place immediately and a further noise impact assessment shall be carried out.  This shall be repeated until the assessment has reached the required standard.  Once a

Condition : 6 - The air extraction mechanical plant, vents, duct and flues, and louvre enclosed air conditioning unit, to be installed within or to the buildings' ground floor commercial unit hereby permitted shall be installed and operate in accordance with the submitted proposed drawings, manufacturer specifications, odour impact assessment (Ref: Unreferenced Kitchen Extraction System Report and Odour Risk Assessment Received: 28 July 2026) and noise impact assessment (Ref: Environmental Noise Assessment Received: 26 August 2026), and be permanently maintained as specified thereafter in accordance with manufacturer guidelines.  

Reasons:  To protect public health, the local environment and neighbour living conditions.

Condition : 7 - The air extraction mechanical plant and air conditioning unit hereby permitted shall be operated between the hours of 07:00 to 23:00 from Monday to Sunday only.  

Reason:  To prevent late evening and nighttime noise disturbance to neighbouring residential properties.

Condition : 8 - The rear door of No. 34 Devonshire Road's single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used or opened after 20:00 hours from Monday to Sunday, except for emergency access or evacuation purposes only.  

Reason:  To prevent late evening and nighttime noise disturbance to neighbouring residential properties.

Condition : 9 - The two additional roof lights to the existing single storey rear extension (to No. 32 Devonshire Road) hereby permitted shall not be opened at any time.  

Reasons:  To prevent noise disturbance to neighbouring residential properties.
subdivision_of_building: The proposal only affects the shopfront on the ground floor and the footpath and the 1st -2nd floor rear of the property for the ductwork.
